title: Pawn skill targeting: possession vs co-op
intro: The main pawn (Fighter) as main pawn, with Burst Strike or another lunging skill in slot 1. Open ground, no wild enemies near. Player 2's controller connected. A dummy appears ahead and to the right; you use a skill WITHOUT turning toward it, to see whether the skill finds it on its own.

steps.text: Stand on open ground, camera looking straight ahead. Press End
Dummy appears 7 m ahead, 35 deg to the right. Possessing the main pawn (normal).
NORMAL POSSESSION (keyboard/mouse). Walk the main pawn so the dummy is about 5-8 m away and off to his RIGHT side, camera looking past it. Don't lock on. Press End
Now use skill 1 once, without turning toward the dummy. Then hold still.

expect.label: possession: the lock-on had a target
possession: he turned to face the dummy
possession: the dummy took a hit

steps.text: Release. Starting co-op on the main pawn.
CO-OP (player 2's controller). Walk the main pawn so the dummy is 5-8 m away and off to his RIGHT side. Watch p2tgt on the overlay. Press End
Player 2: L1 + Square (skill 1) once, without steering toward the dummy. Then hold still.

expect.label: co-op: player 2's pawn had a target
co-op: the pawn's aim was set
co-op: he turned to face the dummy
co-op: the dummy took a hit

probes.ehp:
local function near(ch)
  if not ch then return nil end
  local p0 = ch:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
  local em = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.EnemyManager")
  local arr = em and em:call("getAllEnemies"); if not arr then return nil end
  local best, bd
  for i = 0, arr:call("get_Count") - 1 do
    local ok, e = pcall(function() return arr[i]:get_field("_Chara") end)
    if ok and e and (e:call("get_Hp") or 0) > 0 then
      local p = e:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
      local d = math.sqrt((p.x - p0.x) ^ 2 + (p.z - p0.z) ^ 2)
      if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = e, d end
    end
  end
  return best, bd
end
local e = near(H.pawn(0)); return e and e:call('get_Hp')

local pw = H.pawn(0); local e = near(pw); if not (pw and e) then return nil end
local a = pw:call("get_Transform"); local p = a:call("get_Position"); local f = a:call("get_Rotation") * Vector3f.new(0, 0, 1)
local q = e:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
local d = math.deg(math.atan(q.x - p.x, q.z - p.z) - math.atan(f.x, f.z)); d = (d + 180) % 360 - 180
return math.abs(d)

return ok and c and c:call("get_CharaIDString") or "none"
